questions.question:
4Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All crows are rocks.

All rocks are plants.

All plants are flowers.

Conclusions:

(I) All crows are flowers.

(II) Some flowers are rocks
questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a80ff60cc9c781bf1325a3814e68e9f2b235113924cb8fae402b4c86dee2da25.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) All crows are flowers → **True **( As, All crows are rocks, All rocks are plants, All plants are flowers. so, All crows are flowers holds true)

(II) Some flowers are rocks → **True **( As, All crows are rocks, All rocks are plants, All plants are flowers. so,Some flowers are rocks holds true)

Thus, Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question:
E, F, G, H, K, L and N are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order) .

G sits third to the left of K. N sits second to the left of H. Only K sits between L and N. F is not an immediate neighbour of G.

How many people sit between E and N when counted from the right of E?
questions.solution:
Given:

E, F, G, H, K, L and N are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

G sits third to the left of K.

Only K sits between L and N.

N sits second to the left of H.

F is not an immediate neighbour of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ac03f9d0b6b35e35f18d16b95169356ee7db05832618daab967afc934868c04.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa3a633585fb39eb0d0474b80c3580092c6f47e7ef9516feae4c16527eb22493.png] 

Thus, two people sit between E and N when counted from the right of E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

questions.question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means ‘A is the mother of B’,

'A – B' means ‘A is the brother of B’,

'A × B' means ‘A is the wife of B’ and

'A ÷ B' means ‘A is the father of B’.

Based on the above, how is F related to J if ‘F + G × H ÷ I – J’?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A is
 
 

 Symbol
 +
 –
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 to B
 
 

Given: F + G × H ÷ I – J

**F + G** → F is the mother of G.

**G × H** → G is the wife of H.

**H ÷ I** → H is the father of I.

**I – J** → I is the brother of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab99cfc6ba2d6a357dc8ded4ffa08fa269ed493de2f3dd6c1081339b6357b8bb.png] 

Thus, F is the **Mother’s mother** (maternal grandmother) of J.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
